title: Irrationality of ζ(5) — Multi-Assistant Lean 4 & Isabelle/HOL Formal Verification
aiSystem: Claude Opus 5 / 5.5 Multi-Agent Lean Provers + AI-Assisted Preprint
whyItMatters: Forty-eight years after Apéry’s proof for ζ(3), Aabir Fauzan’s proof that ζ(5) is irrational was rapidly verified in Lean 4 by Claude Opus 5/5.5 agents, checked axiom-free in Formal Conjectures, and ported to Isabelle.
summary: On September 17, 2026, Aabir Fauzan (Aalto University) posted a Zenodo preprint (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22826418, disclosing generative AI assistance for checks and editing) proving that ζ(5) = ∑ 1/n⁵ is irrational via rationally normalized Hankel determinants—settling the most famous odd-zeta irrationality problem since Roger Apéry’s 1978 proof for ζ(3). Within days, two independent Lean 4 formalizations verified the result: Moritz Firsching (Google DeepMind, mo271/Zeta5, Sept 23) completed a zero-sorry, standard-axioms-only Lean proof matched via Comparator to Formal Conjectures (merged Sept 29), while Dan Romik directed Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 5.5 multi-agent workflows in Claude Code (danromik/zeta5-irrationality, Sept 25) to formalize Fauzan’s preprint section-by-section in 29,400 lines (conditional only on PNT) while catching and fixing a missing inequality on p. 10. On October 26, 2026, the proof was independently ported to Isabelle/HOL’s Archive of Formal Proofs.
technicalHighlights: Settles the 48-year-old problem of the irrationality of ζ(5) (first individual odd zeta value proved irrational since Apéry’s ζ(3) in 1978).
Claude Opus 5 / 5.5 multi-agent workflows directed by Dan Romik formalized 29,400 lines of Lean 4 following the paper section-by-section and repaired an unproved inequality.
Independently verified axiom-free against DeepMind’s Formal Conjectures (mo271/Zeta5, PR #6517) and cross-verified in Isabelle/HOL’s Archive of Formal Proofs.
caveats: Fauzan’s original mathematical idea came from a human author using AI in a supporting role; AI’s decisive verifiable breakthrough here was the rapid multi-agent Lean 4 formalization, auditing, and gap-repair workflow that confirmed the result within days.

scoreRationale.foundational: Establishes the irrationality of ζ(5), a landmark special-value problem open for 48 years since Apéry’s celebrated 1978 theorem for ζ(3).
scoreRationale.ripple: Showcased how AI Lean formalization agents can audit, repair, and cross-certify shocking outsider preprints in days rather than years.
scoreRationale.verification: Independently certified axiom-free in Lean 4 (Formal Conjectures + Comparator), cross-formalized by Claude agents, and ported to Isabelle/HOL AFP.
scoreRationale.velocity: Moved from an unknown author’s Zenodo preprint to multi-assistant formal certification (Lean 4 + Isabelle) in under six weeks.
